title: Confirm Which Tools/Locations Hold Operational Data (Data Collection Fragmentation Reference)
summary: When gathering operational data in real time, the source indicates you may need to use separate tools and that operational information is collected in 3 or 4 different places. This procedure helps you identify which tool/location holds the specific operational data element you need, aligned with the ongoing effort to narrow toward a standard single location.
when_to_use: Use this when you need to determine where a specific operational data element is collected for real-time troubleshooting/verification, and you suspect the environment uses multiple tools/locations rather than a single consolidated interface.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Identify the specific tool/location that contains the operational data element needed for the current real-time task, using the environment’s current (possibly fragmented) data collection pattern.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the separate tools used for operational data gathering (tool names not specified in the source)
Awareness of the current “3 or 4 different places” where information is being collected (as discovered on-site)

visual_references.description: Frame showing the discussion that real-time data gathering requires separate tools and that information is collected in 3 or 4 different places, with an effort to narrow to a standard single slot/location.

steps.title: Account for fragmented real-time operational data collection across separate tools
steps.purpose: Ensure you plan for the possibility that operational data is not available in one consolidated interface and may require checking multiple tools/locations.
steps.instruction: When you start gathering operational data in real time, treat the data collection as potentially requiring separate tools (not one consolidated interface).
steps.expected_result: You proceed with the understanding that the operational data you need may require checking multiple tools/locations rather than a single place.
steps.healthy_condition: Your data-gathering approach includes checking more than one tool/location if the needed data element is not found in the first place you try.
steps.failure_condition: You assume a single consolidated interface and miss the correct tool/location for the needed operational data element.

actions.label: Confirm data collection is fragmented
actions.exact_action: Note that the source indicates data may require using separate tools (not one consolidated interface).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “in real time, having to go through separate tools to gather the data… [and] 3 or 4 different places where information's being collected… trying to narrow it down to standard… one slot.”

steps.title: Identify the current set of 3 or 4 information collection places
steps.purpose: Determine the candidate tool/location set you may need to check for the operational topic/data element.
steps.instruction: Identify the current set of “3 or 4 different places” where information is being collected for the relevant operational topic.
steps.expected_result: You can list the current 3 or 4 tool/location places that are used to collect the operational information for the topic you are working on.
steps.healthy_condition: Your list of places matches the environment’s current operational data collection pattern (3 or 4 places, per the source framing).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify the set of places used in the current environment for the operational topic.

actions.label: List current collection places
actions.exact_action: Identify the current set of “3 or 4 different places” where information is being collected for the relevant operational topic.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “on our end, we have like 3 or 4 different places where information's being collected… trying to narrow it down to standard… one slot.”

steps.title: Map the needed data element to the correct tool/location
steps.purpose: Reduce time spent by selecting the correct tool/location for the specific operational data element you need.
steps.instruction: If multiple locations exist, determine which location/tool corresponds to the specific data element you need, noting the source’s stated effort to narrow toward a standard single slot/location.
steps.expected_result: You identify the specific tool/location that contains the operational data element you need for the current real-time task.
steps.healthy_condition: The operational data element you need is found in the tool/location you selected (rather than requiring repeated searching across all places).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot determine which tool/location contains the needed operational data element.

actions.label: Select correct data holder
actions.exact_action: Determine which location/tool corresponds to the specific data element you need.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot determine which tool/location contains the needed data, stop and request guidance from the team responsible for standardization (as implied by the source discussion).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “they're trying to narrow it down to standard… one slot to talk to them.”

success_criteria: You can name the relevant tool(s)/location(s) that contain the needed operational data element, consistent with the source’s “separate tools” and “3 or 4 different places” framing.
healthy_conditions: Operational data gathering proceeds by checking the correct tool/location for the needed data element rather than repeatedly searching across all places.
failure_conditions: You cannot identify the current 3 or 4 information collection places for the operational topic.
You cannot map the needed data element to the correct tool/location.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot determine which tool/location contains the needed operational data, stop and request guidance from the team responsible for standardization (implied by the source discussion about narrowing to a standard single slot).
